trace = [
  {"step":1,"file":"mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c","function":"codegen","line":1845,"var":"tree->car","code":"case NODE_CASE: { ... if (tree->car) { head = cursp(); codegen(s, tree->car, VAL); } }","note":"The case expression is compiled first and its value is kept in a temporary stack slot referenced by head."},
  {"step":2,"file":"mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c","function":"codegen","line":1859,"var":"n = tree->car->car","code":"while (tree) { n = tree->car->car; pos1 = pos2 = JMPLINK_START; while (n) { ... } }","note":"Each when-clause iterates over its pattern list, generating conditional branches that may be linked later."},
  {"step":3,"file":"mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c","function":"codegen","line":1875,"var":"pos2","code":"tmp = genjmp2(s, OP_JMPIF, cursp(), pos2, NOVAL); pos2 = tmp;","note":"Every pattern emits a forward JMPIF whose destination is chained through pos2 for later backpatching."},
  {"step":4,"file":"mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c","function":"dispatch_linked","line":580,"var":"pos","code":"for (;;) { pos = dispatch(s, pos); if (pos==0) break; }","note":"The linked jump chain is resolved by repeatedly dispatching each recorded jump site."},
  {"step":5,"file":"mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c","function":"dispatch","line":565,"var":"newpos = (int16_t)PEEK_S(s->iseq+pos0)","code":"newpos = (int16_t)PEEK_S(s->iseq+pos0); emit_S(s, pos0, (uint16_t)offset);","note":"dispatch reads the existing 16-bit jump displacement from the bytecode buffer before overwriting it, and the reported bug is a 1-byte OOB read here when the linked position points at the end of the heap buffer."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
